tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have provided at least 1 personnel on average in three financial years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26).or Similar Man power Service value not less than Rs 1.35 Lakhs in Last Three year in any one year
Achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.2.70 Lakhs (should have in the last Three years i.e., 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs 0.81 Lakhs Credit lines/ letters of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc.(Conditional Banker Certificate is Not acceptable )
The bidder should submit a valid firm registration certificate
